description: Land Acquisition - Compensation for the Land Acquired Galbokkawatta, Medaherenthuuwa, Getagahawela Watta, Bogahamulahena, Medadumbara D/S Division. Kandy District . (Section 33)
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition notices published under Section 33 of the Land Acquisition Act. It details specific land parcels being acquired for public purposes (Knuckles Reserve and water supply scheme), including land descriptions, extents, compensation amounts, and legal case references. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it deals with land acquisitions and property matters.
